name: IntegrateIT Lutron HomeWorks QS
notes: Two-way Control4 integration for a classic Lutron HomeWorks QS processor over Lutron's published Integration Protocol (LIP) on telnet. Up to 8 mapped OUTPUT integration IDs — dimmer levels with fade, raise / lower / stop for Sivoia QS shades — with live level feedback, per-zone variables, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
